source_evidence.exact_claim: For equivariant holomorphic vector bundles E and F on X, extension classes of E by F correspond naturally to Ext^1_{O_X,G}(X;O(E),O(F)), and this group is canonically H^1(X;G,O(E^dual tensor F)).
source_evidence.source_assessment: The candidate states the classification and the exact p.219 coefficient sheaf. Baer compatibility is a proved structural refinement, not unsupported source overreach.

findings: The bundle-module equivalence transports equivariant bundle extensions to equivariant module extensions and back.
Because O(E) is finite locally free, every module extension is locally split after forgetting G, so its middle term is finite locally free and corresponds to a holomorphic vector bundle.
Full faithfulness transports the maps and equivalences of extensions, and the additive equivalence preserves the pullback-pushout construction defining Baer sum.
The existing finite-locally-free Yoneda lemma supplies the Ext^1 classification and the existing locally-free edge isomorphism supplies H^1 of the internal Hom.
The equivariant evaluation isomorphism O(E^dual tensor F) is canonically the internal Hom from O(E) to O(F), giving the exact p.219 coefficient.
